messages:
maria_dev: Heads up — SDK 1.5.0 changed the streaming frame header format. Canary runtime 2.14.1 is exposing a different chunking behavior and we're seeing a tiny spike in 'unexpected-frame' decoder errors from customer-beta-3. @sam_runtime can you confirm?

sam_runtime: I can see the canary traces. runtime 2.14.1 switched delimiter for streamed frames to align with the new SDK framing. We had planned to keep runtime pinned to 2.13.x until SDK 1.5 rolled out, so not sure how canary got the unpin.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-unpin-trigger by @lee_release at 2025-07-18T10:12Z (run id: dpl-8291)

lee_release: that was me — I pruned old entries from the pinlist to clear cruft and accidentally removed the runtime pin. Missed the SDK compatibility check, my bad. Rolling back is an option but we could also ship a compatibility shim in runtime (feature-flagged) if that's faster.

izzy_oncall: saw error spikes from customer-beta-3 around 10:15Z, stack: 'unexpected frame type in client decoder'. Suggest we lock stable clusters to 2.13.4 now and keep 2.14.1 only on the explicit SDK-1.5 canary. :rotating_light:

sam_runtime: Agreed. Plan: re-apply pin to runtime 2.13.4 for non-canary clusters immediately. Keep 2.14.1 for the 5% canary that updated to SDK 1.5. I'll open a hotfix branch to reintroduce the old delimiter behind a feature flag (legacy_stream_frames=true). That avoids a broad rollback while we validate.

qa_jamal: we can validate the shim in staging using the 'streaming-smoke' runbook. Need a build in ~30m and the test set.

maria_dev: Action items: 1) @sam_runtime create revert-shim PR (target by 1954321300), 2) @lee_release draft release notes and mark migration guidance for streaming clients, 3) @izzy_oncall schedule a short rollback/change window 10:45-11:15Z and inform PS/support. If no objections we'll pin stable clusters and leave the canary as-is.

sam_runtime: PR created: https://repo.internal/infra/changes/1234 — includes feature-flagged shim and unit tests. Patch excerpt:
```
-- runtime: reintroduce legacy frame delimiter for backwards compat
+ feature_flag: legacy_stream_frames = true
```

lee_release: added a line to the release notes draft and linked PR. Will include migration snippet for SDK users and note the pinned clusters. Also pinging support to pre-empt escalations.

izzy_oncall: scheduling rollback/pin window now. Notifying on-call rotations and the PS lead for customer-beta.

deploy-bot: pinlist updated: pinned runtime 2.13.4 -> affected clusters: stable-*; unpinned clusters: canary-1 (5%). change-id: pin-9753

maria_dev: Thanks. We'll keep the legacy flag turned on for 48h and monitor 'streaming_decoder_errors' and p50 latency. If errors > 0.5% or customer impact increases, we'll do a full rollback. :thumbsup:

sam_runtime: monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.prod/streams/d-diff — will post metric updates there.

maria_dev: closing thread unless critical regressions appear. Keep updates in the dashboard or ping me directly.
